text:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — prepping mariner-3b onboarding for the model catalog. Running preflight tonight. Need quick answers on weights URI, tokenizer quirks, config lint, and regional canary plan. Who's available? :raising_hand:

Liam: Weights live at s3://redwood-models/mariner/3b/sha256:abcd1234 (us-west-2). There's a size mismatch vs manifest (2.60 GB vs 2.59 GB) — likely compression header. Can replicate to EU/APAC if we want regional pins.

Maya: Tokenizer note: mariner uses a custom pre-tokenizer that treats curly quotes and compound emoji clusters specially. Current tokenizers in runtimes repo miss the pre-split rule for U+2019 (curly apostrophe) so sequences expand ~6% in chat traces. I have a tiny patch ready (tokenizers/mariner/pretokenizer.py) that fixes it.

AJ: If we do a canary, propose: 3% traffic for 4h -> 15% for 12h -> then ramp to 50% gradually. Gate on metrics: latency P95 < 200ms, token cost diff < 3%, error rate < 0.5%. Regions: start in eu-west-1 only, then add us-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 after stable.

Liam: Suggest fallback variant = mariner-3b-quant (int8) to preserve latency/throughput if KV/cache problems show up. Also we should pin the initial catalog version as mariner-3b@2026-03-10 to make rollbacks explicit.

Sasha: Catalog config I had in mind (example):
```yaml
model_id: mariner-3b
version: 2026-03-10
weights_uri: s3://redwood-models/mariner/3b/sha256:abcd1234
variants:
  - name: mariner-3b
    flavor: fp16
  - name: mariner-3b-quant
    flavor: int8
canary_policy:
  start_percent: 3
  steps:
    - percent: 15
      duration: 12h
fallback_variant: mariner-3b-quant
regions: [eu-west-1]
```

Infra-bot: preflight results: config-lint -> WARN: missing field 'latency_slo' (recommend add), ERROR: fallback_variant field missing from submitted catalog blob (0.1), checksum check -> expected sha256 abcd1234, actual sha256 abcd1235. Please re-check upload.

Deploy-bot: Canary scheduled (tentative) Mon 2026-03-23 09:00 UTC in eu-west-1. I can create the canary route and pin rollout steps once we confirm weights + manifest. :shipit:

Maya: Workaround for runtimes until we land the pretokenizer: set runtime hint tokenization.pre_split = true in model config, which applies pre-splitting for curly quotes. Example runtime override: `{"tokenization": {"pre_split": true}}`. That reduces sequence length delta to ~0.8% in our chat test harness.

Liam: I'll re-upload corrected weights and regenerate manifest with sha256:abcd1234 (was a tooling off-by-one in tar). Will push new object to the same s3 path and ping here when done.

AJ: Once @liam confirms, I'll trigger bucket replication to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 and create IAM roles for private customers if needed.

SRE: eu-west-1 capacity check: we have spare GPU quota on dedicated pools for a 5% canary, ok for initial rollout. Need Prod-SLA approval for >20% traffic.

Sasha: Great — action items captured: @liam re-upload + correct manifest, @aj replicate to eu & apac after upload, @maya open PR for runtime pretokenizer and a short patch to set tokenization.pre_split as default for mariner, @sre confirm any SLA gating for >20%. I'll wait for the new manifest then schedule the canary via Deploy-bot. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Liam: Re-upload done. New manifest sha256:abcd1234. Posted artifact and updated object metadata.

Infra-bot: re-run checks -> all green except a noncritical lint about 'latency_slo' missing. Canary policy OK.

Sasha: Perfect. I'll kick the canary tomorrow morning and follow the metric gates. If anything unexpected, fallback to mariner-3b-quant and roll back to mariner-2b-stable. :eyes:
